title: Te Rongo Harikoa i te Kaumātuatanga
intro: Kei te kite koe i tētahi wā e whakaoho ake ana te tumanako. He tokorua, kua roa kē te pakeke hei mātua, ka whiwhi i tētahi kupu whakaari e whakahē ana i ngā ture o te taiao. Kei waenganui i a rāua tētahi tangata e tū ana, ko tōna oranga tonutanga he tohu o te aroha o te Atua—he wairua kua whakaritea hei poropiti, e mau ana i tētahi taonga tuku iho ka horapa ki ngā whakatupuranga. Ko wai tēnei tangata whakamiharo?
clues: I whānau mai ahau ki ngā mātua kua kaumātuatia, ā, kāore ā rāua tamariki.
Nā ngā anahera i haere mai hei manuhiri ki tōku whānau, i kauwhau i tōku whānau.
I homai ki ahau te whakaaro nui me te poropititanga, ā, e whakahuatia ana ahau i roto i te hunga manawanui.
I karangatia tōku matua ko te hoa o Allah, ā, he taonga ahau ki a ia i ōna tau whakamutunga.
He teina tōku, he poropiti hoki ia, ā, i manaakitia māua tokorua e tō māua Ariki.
He poropiti anō hoki taku tama, ā, i hoatu ki aku uri te karaipiture me te poropititanga.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Poropiti a Ihaka (Ihaka)
Poropiti a Ihimaera (Ihimaera)
Poropiti a Hākupa (Hākopa)
Poropiti a Yahya (Hoani)
Poropiti Uzair (Etera)

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I whānau mai i ngā mātua kaumātua
I maka ki roto i te ahi
I hoatu he rangatiratanga me te taonga
I arahina e ia tōna iwi i Ihipa
I hanga e ia he āaka hei whakaora i te hunga whakapono
trial.answer: I whānau mai i ngā mātua kaumātua

location.label: Huānga Matua

Te rakau e mura ana
Te kuao kau koura
Te aaka o te kawenata

location.answer: Ngā rongopai pai mō tētahi tama

outcome.label: Hua
options: I riro hei poropiti me te whakapapa o ngā poropiti
I riro hei kingi whai rawa
I whakangaromia tōna iwi mō te kore whakapono

I whakawhiwhia ia ki te kaha ki te kōrero i a ia e tamariki ana
outcome.answer: I riro hei poropiti me te whakapapa o ngā poropiti

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
